svg.title: Tools on the garland
svg.desc: Toolbox hung as tags on marigold garlands. Languages: Python, Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS; Backend: FastAPI, Django, Flask, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL; Data + Ml: Pandas, Seaborn, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV; Apps + Ops: React, Android, Docker, Linux, Git.
